knowledge.purpose: Button that copies a value to the clipboard and confirms with a transient tick
useCases: Copy an API key, token, or ID
Copy a share link or referral code
Copy a code snippet or command
antiPatterns: Navigation to another page — use control.link
Toggling a boolean — a copy button performs one action and holds no state
knowledge.implementation:
